name: Journey Confidence Safety Invariant
plain_language: A charging plan is strictly forbidden and vetoed if the lower bound (q10) of predicted arrival SOC falls below the 10% reserve threshold (journey confidence lower bound < 90%).
cedar_statement:
forbid (principal, action == Action::"SendNudge", resource)
when { context.journeyConfLbBps < 9000 };

name: Physical Invariants Verification
plain_language: All Python physical sanity invariants (energy conservation, non-negative battery capacity, valid C-rates, SOC in [0, 1]) must pass without exception before authorization.
cedar_statement:
forbid (principal, action == Action::"SendNudge", resource)
unless { context.invariantsOk == true };

name: Driver Quiet Hours
plain_language: No push notifications or nudges may be sent during late night quiet hours (23:00 to 06:00 IST), protecting drivers from sleep disruption.
cedar_statement:
forbid (principal, action == Action::"SendNudge", resource)
when { context.quietHours == true };

name: Attention Fatigue Cap
plain_language: A maximum of 3 notifications per driver per 24-hour window is enforced. Any excess persuasion attempts are suppressed to prevent notification habituation.
cedar_statement:
forbid (principal, action == Action::"SendNudge", resource)
when { context.nudgesToday >= 3 };

name: User Opt-Out Consent
plain_language: If an EV owner has opted out or muted smart charging recommendations, GridNudge immediately ceases all persuasion actions.
cedar_statement:
forbid (principal, action == Action::"SendNudge", resource)
when { context.optedOut == true };

name: Vehicle & Charger Compatibility
plain_language: Nudges recommending public DC fast charging or scheduled AC start must verify vehicle connector and onboard telemetry support beforehand.
cedar_statement:
forbid (principal, action == Action::"SendNudge", resource)
unless { context.vehicleSupportsPlan == true };
